info.name: Internship & Job Application Portal - Backend API (v2)
info.description: Matches the actual built backend exactly. Folders are ordered to match the required dependency chain: register/login -> profile -> company -> company approval -> job -> job approval -> apply -> interview -> dashboard -> admin views -> negative tests -> cleanup (run last, it's destructive). Run npm run seed first so the admin/candidate/recruiter accounts referenced in Auth exist, OR just use the Register requests here instead of the seeded accounts.

item.name: 1. Auth
item.description: Run first. Uses fresh Register+Login accounts by default so it doesn't depend on seed data (except the Admin login, which needs 'npm run seed' to have been run at least once).

item.name: Register As Admin - Should Fail With 403
Login Admin (requires npm run seed to have been run)
Get My Profile (empty shell before first update)
3. Company
item.description: Company must be admin-approved before the recruiter can post jobs — that approval step lives here so the flow order matches reality.

item.name: Approve Company (Admin) - required before recruiter can post jobs
Update My Company (resets to pending again)
4. Jobs
item.description: Includes a request that intentionally fails (posting a job under an unapproved company) to prove that rule is enforced.

item.name: Create Job Before Company Approved - Should Fail With 403

exec: pm.test('Blocked - company not approved', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });

body.raw:

  "title": "Junior Backend Developer",

  "salaryMax": 50000,
  "deadline": "2026-12-31"
}

item.name: Get Public Jobs - New Job Should NOT Appear Yet (still pending)
Get Job By Id As Owner (visible even though pending)
Update Job (Recruiter, ownership check, resets to pending)
Update Job As Wrong Recruiter - Should Fail With 403

exec: pm.test('Blocked - not job owner', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });

item.name: Get Applicants For Job (Recruiter, ownership check)
Apply Again - Should Fail With Duplicate Error (400)

exec: pm.test('Duplicate application rejected with 400', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });

item.name: Update Application Status - Wrong Recruiter Should Fail (403)

exec: pm.test('Non-owner recruiter rejected with 403', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });

item.name: 7. Dashboard
item.description: Run before Cleanup — dashboards need the candidate account still active.

item.name: 9. Negative / Auth Guard Tests
item.description: Proves terminal-status locking and role guards actually work, not just that happy paths work.

item.name: Wrong Role Access - Candidate Hits Admin Route - Should Return 403
Apply After Terminal Rejection - Recruiter Tries Reopening Without Admin - Should Fail (400)
Recruiter Tries Changing Own Rejected Application Again - Should Fail (400)

exec: pm.test('Terminal status blocked for non-admin', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });

item.name: Admin Overrides Terminal Status - Should Succeed
10. Cleanup (run LAST — destructive)
item.description: Deactivates the test candidate and deletes the test job. Running this earlier will break every request after it in this collection.

item.name: Deactivated User Can No Longer Access API - Should Return 401

exec: pm.test('Deactivated user blocked with 401', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });
